title: 老转灯
logline: 记录老城区经营三十年的理发店老板最后一次营业、关停店铺的过程，呈现老手艺的谢幕时刻。

shots.narrationEn: This rotating lamp has been lit for thirty years.
shots.visual: A middle-aged barber in a slightly frayed white coat gently wipes the old red-and-white rotating lamp mounted above the door of his decades-old barbershop in the old town.
shots.ttsDirection: 情绪沉静怀旧，语速舒缓偏慢，『三十年』重读，气息下沉带感慨，句尾稍作停顿

shots.narrationEn: Every regular customer's hair has been cut by my hands.
shots.visual: The barber skillfully trims the gray hair of an elderly regular customer seated in the worn barber chair, with vintage scissors and combs scattered on the counter beside them.
shots.ttsDirection: 情绪平和带暖意，语速平稳，『都我剃的』重读，气息稳，带点不易察觉的自豪感

shots.narrationEn: I've wiped these mirrors tens of thousands of times.
shots.visual: The barber wipes the fogged wall mirror with a clean rag, the reflection showing the half-packed tool bag on the counter and the empty shop space.
shots.ttsDirection: 情绪细腻眷恋，语速稍缓，『上万遍』重读，气息轻缓，带点对日常的牵挂感

shots.narrationEn: Some doors close because their work is done.
shots.visual: The barber carefully unscrews the rotating lamp from its mounting bracket above the door, soft morning light streaming into the quiet, half-empty shop.
shots.ttsDirection: 情绪释然通透，语速放缓，『完成了』重读，气息放轻，带点豁达的停顿感

shots.narrationEn: Great craftsmanship deserves a fine razor.
shots.visual: The barber places the disassembled rotating lamp into a cardboard box, with a sleek branded manual razor resting beside it on the worn countertop.
shots.ttsDirection: 情绪沉稳笃定，语速平缓，『好手艺』『好刀』重读，气息稳，句尾收住留余韵
